rv.q: Incoherency is no real barrier to your enjoyment of this deliriously funny tale set in a young Shakespeare fan’s imagination
A World Elsewhere is nothing short of exquisite and I'd frankly give it a million stars out of 10.
This is a wildly inventive adventure complete with smoking trapdoors, enormous menacing puppets, and plenty of audience participation.
A World Elsewhere is a terrific show for a family treat, appealing across all age groups.

cn.t: Critics praise this imaginative family show for its inventive celebration of creativity and bonkers interactive fun, though some question whether its Shakespeare connection truly lands with young audiences.
